column1: # script-VM object push adapters - EC-7 family C, declared on this directory's page
# RESTRICTED to the body sizes that carry the shared idiom. The tag chose the
# candidates; the bytes chose the members.

# Shape: two variants of one idiom: 188 at 21 B push the object directly; 116 at 31 B add a member offset with a null guard (cmove to 0) and differ ONLY in that offset immediate - 8, 1, 0x30, 0x10 - which is why a mask over call/lea operands alone reports them as four shapes.
# Control: all 304 tail-jump to ONE target, 00684080.
#   0063A110 (51 B) makes a VIRTUAL call through [rcx+8] instead of pushing directly; it is a different idiom and is excluded
# NOT dispositioned: the shared implementations these members jump or call into, and
# whatever object or member each adapter names.
# One function entry address per line, VA (image base 0x00120000 included).
